GET vs POST forms
GET search · Search · shoes /search?q=shoes · POST signup · POST /signup · Email · Request body: · a@example.com · email=a%40example.com
Read the diagram step by step

GET serializes fields into a query string; POST sends data in the request body. Neither is
inherently confidential. Use HTTPS for both and use GET only for safe retrieval.
GET data URL query එJකේ තිJයෙනවා. POST data request body එJකේ තිJයෙනවා. POST වි+රකේ secure JනJවයි; HTTPS සහ server validation අවශ්‍යයි.
